title: INS Udaygiri, INS Kavaratti dock in Vietnam as India expands Indo-Pacific naval presence
summary: Indian Navy warships INS Udaygiri and INS Kavaratti have arrived in Vietnam, marking a significant step in deepening defense ties. This deployment highlights India's growing naval presence and its commitment to maritime security in Southeast Asia.
